title: Claims Computation Sheet: Beneficiary Share and Death Claim Interest on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
Computation of a beneficiary's share of an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities death benefit and of the death claim interest paid with it.

## Formal statement

1. **Death benefit.** The death benefit is the contract value once the valuation interest is credited — the contract value as the activity history then stands: premiums received plus interest credited, less withdrawals, surrender charges and death benefit payments.
2. **Claimant's share.** The claimant's share is the claimant's share percent in the beneficiary designation, times the death benefit, rounded to the cent. Where a primary beneficiary named in the designation died before the owner, as shown by an Ashgrove death claim on a policy insuring that beneficiary, that beneficiary's share passes to the surviving primaries pro rata: a surviving primary's share percent is divided by one hundred less the predeceased share percent and multiplied by one hundred.
3. **Interest period.** The death claim interest runs from the valuation date, which is the date the valuation interest closed on, to the payment date, in actual calendar days.
4. **Interest.** It is the claimant's share times the product's death claim interest rate times those days over 365, simple, rounded to the cent.

## Reading the records

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Claimant | The claimant named on the death claim recorded on the contract |
| Claimant's share percent | The claimant's line in the beneficiary designation in effect |
| A predeceased primary | A primary named in the designation whose death, before the owner's, is shown by a death claim on an Ashgrove policy insuring that person |
| Valuation date | The end of the interest period of the contract's latest interest credit — the valuation interest |
| Payment date | The day of the lump-sum election |
| Death claim interest rate | The product's figure in the claims reference table |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

Death benefit $200000.00. Designation: primaries A 50%, B 30%, C 20%. An Ashgrove death claim on a policy insuring C shows C died before the owner. Claimant A; valuation date 10 March; payment on 19 April; death claim interest rate 3.5%.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| A's share percent: 50 divided by (100 less 20), times 100 | 62.5% |
| A's share: 62.5% of $200000.00 | $125000.00 |
| Days from 10 March to 19 April | 40 |
| Interest: $125000.00 times 0.035 times 40 over 365, rounded | $479.45 |

Had C survived the owner, A's share would be 50% of $200000.00, that is $100000.00.
